purpose: Learn final-submit and destructive action boundaries that are blocked by default.
applies_when: The current flow exposes Submit, Send, Confirm, Pay, Delete, Publish, or account/privacy consent actions.
Clicking the action may submit, pay, delete, send, confirm, or mutate persistent profile/account data.
A learned PathGraph or visual asset has seen the control before but must not authorize it.
trace_requirements: Record danger text and active container scope.
Record final review extraction or reconciliation evidence.
Record structured authorization decision when final submit is ever allowed.
success_conditions: Danger action is detected in the active scope.
No final submit/send/confirm/payment/delete action executes without structured authorization.

seek_source.lesson: SEEK final submit is not a normal click; it requires scoped detection and explicit structured authorization.
